story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: Identify inbound Eligibility Date, Assessment Date, and Maintenance Date for transaction effective date selection
gaps: Status field for id "TC_002" is "Negative" while scenario type is "Positive"

Description field contains off-scenario negative intent: "Validate that an AR PASSE inbound 834 file that does not contain a valid effective date in Loop 2000 DTP03, does not contain a valid assessment date in Loop 2300 HD03, and does not contain a valid maintenance date source is not allowed to populate a transaction effective date in Facets."
Status field is "Edge" for id "TC_003" but no step Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record

scenarios.title: Use Eligibility Date as transaction effective date for new enrollment before eligibility starts
gaps: Status field for id "TC_TS002_003" is "Edge" but no Test Step Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record. Example Expected Result text: "The transmission status is Completed and Validation Status is Accepted."

scenarios.title: Use Assessment Date as transaction effective date when current eligibility exists and Assessment Date changes
Use Assessment Date and retain relevant fields when only Assessment Date changes on current eligibility
gaps: check 12 failed for Id "TC_TS004_002": Status field is "Negative" but this test case is off-scenario for the supplied positive scenario acceptance criteria "Given an inbound EDI 834 file, if the Assessment Date has changed and none of the relevant fields have changed, the Assessment Date populates as the transaction effective date, maintaining values of relevant fields."; gate cap applied because the batch was instructed for one scenario with 3 test cases and this case validates a different intent: "Validate that the Assessment Date only rule is not treated as satisfied when the inbound AR PASSE current eligibility update changes Assessment Date and also changes one relevant field such as Assessment Tier."

check 12 failed for Id "TC_TS004_003": Status field is "Edge" but no Test Step Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record. Examples from Test Step Expected Result include "The transaction is accepted with Disposition status Completed and does not show an error, rejection, or intake-hold outcome for the same-day Assessment Date condition." and "No error, rejection, or absent-record condition is present for the same-day Assessment Date edge case, no incorrect-data MELC exception row is created for the processed update, and the transaction effective date in FACETS reflects the submitted same-day Assessment Date while the relevant field values remain unchanged."

scenarios.title: Use Eligibility Date for relevant field changes received before eligibility start when Assessment Date is unchanged
gaps: Status field contains "Edge" but no Test Step Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record for id "TC_TS005_003". Example Expected Results quoted: "The file appears in TM search results.", "The transmission shows no FXI or policy unit error and reflects Accepted or Completed/Success status.", "The transaction effective date in Facets equals the future eligibility date from the inbound 834 for the Pregnancy change, confirming the boundary condition is processed correctly and validated."

scenarios.title: Use Maintenance Date for relevant field changes after eligibility start when Assessment Date is unchanged
